name: Monkys House
summary:
Monkys House!

Welcome to Monkys House, Are you new? Oh boy I love new people! I’ll show you around…

Here in the world of Mokies, we run around on our Front Paws!

You can buy Cosmetics to wear and show off the true you, and mess around with friends!

Want to Build? No worries! Our Networked Sandbox Mode will let you build games with friends! Making the game NEVER get old.

What are you waiting for? Move in! And join us, in Monkys House!
